<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    bird=None; pink=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'): bird=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
        if n['color']=='P': pink=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    N=sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    S=[n['pixels'] for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S']
    return dict(step=f.step,bird=bird,pink=pink,N=N,S=S)
print("before",snap(current_frame))
res=action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT1",snap(current_frame),"done",res.get('done'),"lvl",res.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(f):
    bird=None; pink=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'): bird=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
        if n['color']=='P': pink=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    N=sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    S=[n['pixels'] for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='S']
    return dict(step=f.step,bird=bird,pink=pink,N=N,S=S)
